text:
```yaml
name: Promote Dev Profile Images

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  promote-dev-profile-images:
    name: Promote Dev Profile Images
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler

      - name: Run dev profile image promotion
        run: |
          cargo run -p hushd --bin promote-dev-profile-images
```
